title: Secrets Veil: three layers between the tool and the model
description: A tool prints a secret; the model must never read it. The veil arms at session.start and rewrites every tool result: values named by one of 21 vendor variables, value shapes like vendor token prefixes and PEM blocks, and high-entropy tokens at 4.3 bits per char, a bar hex can never cross (16 symbols cap at 4.0), so git shas and hashes survive. No reveal path: covered stays covered. Arm a value and watch which layer catches what, all synthetic.
